english_draft: Historical reconstruction: ORCL calendar Q3 2026 preview. This is a historical reconstruction. It was not published before the earnings date. Oracle released fiscal Q4 2026 results on June 10, 2026. Total quarterly revenue was USD 19.2 billion. This was up 21% year over year. Cloud revenue was USD 9.9 billion. This was up 47% year over year. Cloud infrastructure revenue was USD 5.8 billion. This was up 93% year over year. Cloud applications revenue was USD 4.1 billion. This was up 10% year over year. RPO increased from USD 553 billion to USD 638 billion. RPO is contracted backlog, not recognized revenue. The next quarter is calendar Q3 2026, which is Oracle fiscal Q1 2027. The key question is whether cloud infrastructure growth stays near 90%. The second key question is whether cloud applications growth stays in double digits. The third key question is whether total revenue growth stays above 20%. Positive surprise: cloud infrastructure grows near 90% or above, or RPO keeps increasing strongly. Negative surprise: cloud applications growth drops below 10%, or RPO growth slows or reverses. Verification points: check total revenue; check cloud revenue, cloud infrastructure, and cloud applications; check RPO; check GAAP and non-GAAP operating income and EPS.
reader_questions: RPO 是合约积压而非已确认收入，那么用 RPO 环比增加 85B 美元来推断下季收入，是否会把未来多年合同的全部金额误当成近期收入？
云基础设施 +93%、云应用 +10% 与总云收入 +47% 是否都按同一美元、同比口径计算？如果口径或币种不一致，分部加总是否仍然成立？
如果下季总营收仍增长约 20%，但云基础设施增速明显低于 90%，应该把差异归因于合同转化节奏，还是云需求本身放缓？
fact_checks: 来源 URL 标题显示为 Oracle Q4 and FY 2026 Results，发布日期为 2026-06-10，与任务给定一致。
总季度营收 19.2B 美元、同比 +21%，出自官方新闻稿。
云收入 9.9B、同比 +47%；云基础设施 5.8B、同比 +93%；云应用 4.1B、同比 +10%，分部加总等于 9.9B。
RPO 季度内由 553B 增至 638B，来源明确说明是 contracted backlog，不是已确认收入。
GAAP 经营利润 6.1B、非 GAAP 经营利润 8.6B；GAAP EPS 1.45、非 GAAP EPS 2.11，均为公司披露。
来源未提供市场共识、股价或未披露的产品利润，因此本稿未编造这些数据。
